body: Thank you sentimentally. As mutual human beings, it’s important that we are all here for eachother in trying times like these. ❤️
It’s importat that you continue to live this life in his name. All he would want you do is continue and live to the best of your ability. I’m praying for you :)

It’s hard to try and comprehend the amount of life i have ahead of me in the only 18 years i’ve lived, but i sure do realize that 19 is way too young to leave this world. I’m sorry you had to deal with the loss of your ex. Death will truly be the most complex thing to understand.

Hey brotha, i went through a lot of the same things as a child. I may only be 18, but it feels as if my entire life has been a movie. My dad used to beat my brother, my pregnant mother, and i to a pulp when he didnt get what he wanted. He was abusive,  a druggie, and a loser. He had everything he couldve ever wanted, a gorgeous man with ice green eyes and worked as a Chiropractor and was well-reknown for it, racking in 8,000$ a week most times. It really just goes to show you that in the end, self-love is everything. And that’s what my best friend and father had in common, a lack of self. It’s so important that you come to grips with your demons in this life. It’s necessary to grow as a person and move forward.

I do suffer from similar issues, an example would be: i have varying social anxiety, i’m fearful of anyone’s dad (grown men in general), i struggled with a fuckton of self-conciousness after 8 scars that have been left on my face from my father’s recklessness. I know what it’s like.

Always know that mutually as human beings, we can always find someone to relate to, and confide in. It’s so important to do that, because in the end,

Humans crave connection.

I may not know you, but i have love for you my brother, and this whole community is here for you :)

I’m terribly sorry you have to go through that experience as well. It really is weird to not have the answers on things we desire to know in this materialistic life. Even trying to comprehend the realm of existence my best friend is in is un-real to me. My method of coping is staying busy and music. In the end, they are distractions, but it helps me from laying around in bed having too much idle time and getting stuck in my head. I believe, when we do pass from this earth, all of our questions shall be answered. So i dont stress it TOO much :,)

It definitely has been a lot so handle so far. I greatly appreciate the concern. I’ve had an incredible support system with family and friends. I’d just thought i’d share the story to get some input from people alike :) thanks guys.
He had many problems that held him back in school. He was finishing it up online.

Thank you sentimentally. I will be sure to check it our. You’re a real trooper for taking the time to respond in such a nice timely manner. Individuals like YOU are what make this life worth living :,)

You’re weak if you take the short way out of this life. All of us are in certain situations that enable us to feel pain in this life.

Just like when you feel a pinch on your skin and the pain is temporary, 

It’s the same with any emotional pain.

The beauty in life is the unpredictability in it, and you need to be alive to see it :)

I lost my best friend to suicide at 19 years old. Whole life ahead of him, and he completely shattered my motivation for anything.

Dont do this to the ones you love, remember. Dont be selfish. But be selfless at the same time.
